snippet.title: Trail Out – Out Now On PS5 | Destruction Racing Hits PlayStation 5
snippet.description:
Trail Out is officially available on PlayStation 5!
Start Playing Now: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/JP6576-PPSA24855_00-0963534990981173

Get ready for explosive derby racing where speed meets total destruction. Smash through environments, wreck your opponents, and dominate the track in a high-octane racing experience built for chaos.

With over 70 vehicles, 40 diverse locations, and multiple explosive game modes, Trail Out delivers nonstop mayhem. Race sports cars, tanks, school buses, and outrageous vehicles across dynamic tracks where every obstacle can become a weapon.

Customize your vehicles, unleash destruction, and fight to be the last car standing.

Key Features
70+ vehicles to unlock and customize
40 destructible locations
Explosive derby racing gameplay
Multiple game modes including battle royale, stunt challenges, and zombie battles
Split-screen multiplayer for up to 4 players
Trail Out brings intense destruction racing to PlayStation 5 with massive crashes, chaotic races, and adrenaline-fueled action.

#TrailOut #PS5 #PlayStation5 #DestructionRacing
